risk_if_not_implemented: Without Privileged User Oversight, users, services and processes may obtain or retain access beyond authorized need, enabling misuse or escalation. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Conflict of Interest (COI) / Undue Influence / Insider Misconduct (MT-15).

compensating_control_1.name: Conformity Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to validate that Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) conform to the organization's security, compliance and/or resilience policies, standards and other applicable requirements.
compensating_control_1.justification: Conformity Monitoring (CPL-05) provides periodic assessment and assurance that compensates for the absence of Privileged User Oversight (MON-14.2) by providing structured evaluation of the environment to surface gaps and verify residual control effectiveness. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Monitoring Reporting
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to provide an event log report generation capability to aid in detecting and assessing anomalous activities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Monitoring Reporting (MON-06) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Privileged User Oversight (MON-14.2) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
